en: A black-and-white panoramic image of a European town nestled among rolling hills and forests. The town features a mixture of multi-story residential buildings, historic-looking houses, and a few larger institutional or possibly industrial buildings with a chimney. The background shows cultivated fields and patches of forest, with a prominent hilltop structure—possibly a monastery, castle, or large villa—surrounded by trees.
